study_type_evidence.quote: Mice (n=9) were intravenously injected via the tail vein with 0.44±0.08 MBq of [125I]SST-scFv8D3.
one group was given a single intravenous injection of SST-scFv8D3 (2 mg/kg) and the second group received a single intravenous injection of PBS
The primary neurons were treated with 1 μM of SST peptide (PeptaNova 4032), SST-scFv8D3 or scFv8D3 for 24 h at 37 ºC.
study_type_evidence.section: METHODS - Neprilysin activity measurement in vitro

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: C57Bl/6 wild-type, 7-8 months old (pharmacokinetics and biodistribution); APPswe transgenic on C57Bl/6 background, 14 months old (single-injection study) and 8 months old (three-injection study), both male and female
in_vivo_species.quote: Brain uptake, peripheral biodistribution and plasma half-life of SST-scFv8D3 was investigated in C57Bl/6 wild-type mice (7-8 months-old).

in_vitro_detail: Human neuroblastoma SHSY5Y cells and primary hippocampal/striatal neurons isolated from C57Bl/6 mouse embryos at embryonic day 14, treated with 1 uM (primary neurons) or 10 uM (SHSY5Y) SST, SST-scFv8D3 or scFv8D3 for 24 h and assayed for cell-surface neprilysin activity with a fluorogenic substrate; indirect and competition ELISA against recombinant mouse transferrin receptor.

agents.sequence_source: METHODS - Cloning of SST-scFv8D3: 'A scFv consisting of the heavy and light variable domains of the 8D3 antibody was linked to the N-terminal end of the 14 amino acid SST peptide (AGCKNFFWKTFTSC) through an in-house designed linker (APGSYTGSAPG)... a poly-6 His-tag (HHHHHH) was added'
agents.chemical_identifier: recombinant fusion protein, MW approximately 31 kDa, expressed in Expi293 cells, purity approximately 70%
agents.group_n: n=4/group (single-injection study, 14-month APPswe); n=7/group (three-injection study, 8-month APPswe)
agents.group_n_quote: eight month old APPswe transgenic mice were divided into three groups (n=7/group) where one group was given an intravenous injection of SST-scFv8D3 (1 mg/kg...)
agents.dose: 2 mg/kg single dose (study 1); 1 mg/kg, corresponding to 32 nmol/kg, every 36 h for three injections (study 2)
agents.dose_route_quote: one group was given a single intravenous injection of SST-scFv8D3 (2 mg/kg)... a dose of 1 mg/kg of SST-scFv8D3 was given every 36 h (three injections in total)

agents.dose: 0.44±0.08 MBq per mouse; tracer dose stated as 0.04 mg/kg for the brain-concentration measurements
agents.dose_route_quote: Mice (n=9) were intravenously injected via the tail vein with 0.44±0.08 MBq of [125I]SST-scFv8D3.
agents.half_life_matrix: mouse plasma/blood (expressed as %ID per gram blood)
agents.pk_quote: The plasma half-life of the recombinant protein, based on blood samples obtained at 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 6 and 24 h post injection, was around 6 h (Figure 3A). No kinetic phase is named and no model is described, so half_life_phase is 'unspecified'. Brain concentrations after a 0.04 mg/kg tracer dose were 0.49±0.04, 0.42±0.04 and 0.11±0.01 %ID/g at 2, 6 and 24 h; these are biodistribution values and are not labelled Cmax by the paper.
agents.pk_section: RESULTS - Distribution of radiolabeled SST-scFv8D3 in the blood, brain, and peripheral organs

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Plasma concentrations, expressed as percentage of injected dose (%ID) per gram blood of [125I]SST-scFv8D3. The plasma-half-life was estimated to 6 h
concentration_time_figure.note: Plasma radioactivity (%ID per gram blood) versus time after a single intravenous injection, sampled at 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 6 and 24 h. Figure 3B (brain %ID/g at 2, 6 and 24 h) and Figure 3C (brain-to-blood ratio) are additional time-resolved panels.

bioanalytical_method: Gamma counting of iodine-125 radioactivity (1480 Wizard gamma counter, Wallac Oy) in blood, brain and peripheral organs; sandwich ELISA for neprilysin and for Abeta40/Abeta42; fluorogenic substrate assay for neprilysin activity
bioanalytical_quote: Radioactivity in brain, peripheral organs and blood was measured using a χ-counter (1480 Wizard, Wallac Oy, Turku, Finland).
notes: The measured 6 h plasma half-life applies to the iodine-125 labelled construct [125I]SST-scFv8D3 in 7-8 month old wild-type C57Bl/6 mice; the body explicitly cautions that radiolabelling 'could slightly affect the pharmacokinetic properties compared to the non-labelled construct that was used for the therapeutic studies'. No Cmax, Tmax or AUC is reported; brain concentrations of 0.49±0.04, 0.42±0.04 and 0.11±0.01 %ID/g at 2, 6 and 24 h are biodistribution data, not a Cmax, and are recorded only in pk_quote. The '120 times longer' half-life claim and the 3 min half-life for SST alone are based on cited prior literature for SST, not on any measurement made in this paper; SST was deliberately not dosed in vivo here. The paper titles its biodistribution section 'Ex-vivo study', but the design is intact live mice dosed intravenously with organs harvested afterwards for radioactivity counting, so it is classified as in vivo rather than ex vivo under the protocol definition; no tissue was removed and then treated with the compound. The PEPLIFE2 header lists a long concatenated sequence for [125I]SST-scFv8D3; only the portions actually printed in the body (SST peptide, linker, His-tag) are recorded here.
